proposal.change: Make check_dispute_eligibility read the customer's compliance_hold flag (CUS-0006 hold=1) and return eligible=False with the compliance_hold check set to fail, instead of reporting pass.
proposal.diff_preview:
--- a/disputes/eligibility.py
+++ b/disputes/eligibility.py
@@ def check_dispute_eligibility(transaction_id, reason_code):
-    checks["compliance_hold"] = "pass"
+    hold = customers.get_compliance_hold(tx.customer_id)
+    checks["compliance_hold"] = "fail" if hold else "pass"
-    eligible = all(v == "pass" for k, v in checks.items() if k != "compliance_hold")
+    eligible = all(v == "pass" for v in checks.values())
proposal.risk: Blocking disputes for all customers with compliance_hold may change outcomes for other eligible cases and existing open disputes; the hold lookup must match the engine's disputes.check behavior exactly.
